contradictions.what: Rep says there was no moment and nothing to do, yet our analysis arrived three weeks late with fixable findings, after the test finished.
Rep says the uplift number got silence, but Stefan reacted explicitly: 'that's an average. What's mine?'
Rep says 'we weren't really pitching' but we answered with the Authorization Boost deck and uplift averages.
Rep calls account healthy and off every list, yet the customer saw money left on the table and heard from us only when he said he was leaving.
CFO decision was reportedly two weeks before the last call, while our analysis landed after the test ended; rep's account of timing is unclear.
Rep says nobody wanted to rip anything out and customers like the product, yet Stefan asked to split the contract and moved international.
